preservation.reason: The subscription command streamed the incomplete draft to its process output but did not commit it to the requested output file before the connection ended. The command wrapper retained only a truncated display chunk. This record preserves every recoverable failure signal without reconstructing or inventing missing bytes.

disposition: The incomplete draft was rejected. The same still-running command automatically retried its interrupted sampling request, read the frozen packet, and wrote a separate schema-valid final output that passed the repository validator.
